items.topic: Backend API corrections in catalog docs (interceptor, errors, expressions)
items.claim: Docs use ExceptionUtils.createBusinessErrorException, GenericOperationErrorException, Translator.register(), interceptor getOperations without AsmModel
items.fact: Interceptor getOperations(AsmModel) returns operations; postCall runs in registration order. Business errors are modeled faults -> generated <Name>Exception (BusinessErrorException generated per project); ValidationException/AccessDeniedException/NotFoundException are platform errors; ExceptionUtils.createBusinessErrorException and GenericOperationErrorException do not exist. getTransferObjectGraph/getTransferObjectBindings return Optional<...>; EntityTypeExpressions fields are getterAttributeExpressions/getterReferenceExpressions; Translator has no register(), use getTranslators() map. DI via @Reference and @Inject.

items.topic: Best practices cite non-platform helpers as platform API
items.claim: Practices reference WorkflowUtils (x8), AccessRequest (x5), DiagramUtils (x4), GenericActor, ValidationErrorCode (54 identifiers) as platform API
items.fact: These are project helpers, not platform API. Also 6 best-practice files use ExceptionUtils and 1 uses GenericOperationErrorException; interceptor-* practices need getOperations(AsmModel), registration-order postCall, terminateOnException; deployment practice needs current env-var names; remove 'score:' (207 lines).

items.topic: Generated relation-setter DAOs NPE on null relatedObject
items.fact: Generated JUDO DAO relation setters (e.g. setErrorReplacement(entity, relatedObject)) call relatedObject.identifier() unconditionally; passing null throws NullPointerException.

items.topic: Enumeration-typed relation query can return raw Integer (ClassCastException)
items.fact: Querying a generated relation/navigation with enumeration type can return a raw Integer instead of the enum, causing ClassCastException (S19-08).

items.topic: BooleanFilter has no 'is unset' filter for optional booleans
items.fact: SDK BooleanFilter only exposes isTrue()/isFalse(); there is no filter for null/unset optional booleans.

items.topic: Derived attribute through inherited member makes RDBMS query generator omit a JOIN
items.fact: Derived attribute navigating via an inherited attribute breaks the RDBMS query generator (missing JOIN), e.g. lastWorkReport : Binary = self.workReports!any().lastDocument.document where lastDocument is inherited.

items.topic: Multi-module build: install model+schema before sdk; stale ~/.m2 model jar
items.fact: A JUDO app is a Maven reactor (model, schema, sdk, internal, app, common). Installing sdk standalone fails with 'Could not collect dependencies'; use -pl with -o and validateModels=false after installing model+schema. The SDK pom regenerates at generate-sources FROM the installed model jar in ~/.m2, not edited model source, so a stale jar poisons the chain; mvnd may print BUILD SUCCESS while installing stale jars (S17-05, S04-01).

items.topic: Dispatcher refuses operations on immutable bound instances
items.fact: The JUDO dispatcher signs bound-instance identifiers and carries an immutable flag inside the signed identifier; operations on immutable bound instances throw AccessDeniedException (S05-01).

items.topic: Validation message interpolation and localization pipeline
items.fact: JUDO delegates bean validation to a Hibernate Validator OSGi component whose MessageInterpolator resolves messages at runtime: I18nService.getTemplate(message) returns the localized template (raw message used if null), then parameter tokens are interpolated (P29-03).

items.topic: Other agent-docs topics from knowledge-gaps-report
items.fact: Topics listed (agent-docs section): binary upload/download two-phase token flow; SYSTEM/non-principal actors exposure and realm; UI model values that break the generator; long-running operations frontend/proxy 503 timeout; creating/upgrading a JUDO project (archetypes, version updater); static navigations and static data; request tracing (exchange id); low-level persistence hooks; API-level tests with ApiClient/Postman; backend CORS filter config; Flutter frontend build (scope-gated).

items.topic: Best-practices gaps from knowledge-gaps-report
items.fact: Missing patterns: model changes that break generated/custom frontend code; DAO read/write performance (seek, batching, eager owned relations); enforce rules server-side not only in the UI; E2E methodology (baseline dump, real-UI first, time budget).

items.topic: New model blueprints needed
items.fact: New blueprints: offline-mobile-ingest (localId idempotency, two-stage upload, change stamps), offer-cost-price-minimum (+link price-margin-calculation-utilities), partner-scoped-multi-role-users, typed-media-attachment (polymorphic owners), inspection ticketing, jobsheet->certificate pipeline (kind-gated WorkReport completion: WORK_REPORT vs COMPLETION_CERTIFICATE, toDone prerequisite by kind; generateJobSheet valid only before done and without completion certification, button hidden unless condition holds); extend best-practices/model/soft-delete-active-flag.md with retention + age-based cleanup.
